items.title: Update on a security incident involving 1Password’s backend systems
items.blurb: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure.

items.title: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order
items.blurb: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal has rejected the UK government’s attempt to keep its order secret, marking a significant victory for transparency.
